title: polypodium filix-femina var. molle
intro: Polypodium filix-femina var. molle, commonly known as the soft polypody fern, is a variety of the Polypodium filix-femina species, a type of terrestrial fern. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium filix-femina var. molle include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic, while also exhibiting antioxidant and hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
